plan.failureSummary: Deterministic page.ai cache replayed a stale positional selector (#nav > ... > div:nth-of-type(2) > button) that selected the Solutions dropdown instead of Developers, causing navigation to /solutions/use-cases/critical-user-flows/ instead of /docs/.
observedIndicators: Deterministic cached runSource used positional selector '#nav > nav > div:nth-of-type(1) > div:nth-of-type(1) > div:nth-of-type(2) > button' for the Developers menu.
Tool execution logs show this selector clicked the 'Solutions' button (<button class="nav-item" aria-controls="nav-dropdown-solutions">Solutions</button>).
Subsequent navigation landed on 'https://www.checklyhq.com/solutions/use-cases/critical-user-flows/' instead of the intended '/docs/'.
User assertion expect(page.url()).toEqual('https://www.checklyhq.com/docs/') failed due to wrong page state.
Live failure screenshot shows the 'Developers' menu item is intact and visible in the header navigation.

remediationSteps.summary: Clear page.ai cache and retry automation
remediationSteps.details: Invalidate/clear the cached page.ai instructions for checkly.test.ts and re-run the test autonomously.

plan.notes: Clearing the page.ai cache will allow the autonomous agent to re-target the 'Developers' navigation button and find the 'Documentation' link properly.
